page.layout: One printed page, no text blocks. The faint, mirrored lines at the top right and in the upper middle are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from show-through: mirrored lines of text in the upper half (top right, and a short heading-like line with a few lines of text below it), and faint marks lower down. These come from the other side of the leaf and are left out. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed on this side. The edges of the scan show the book's binding and the neighbouring page, which are also left out.
